headline: Absolute error, then one mean
caption: L1 loss keeps each absolute error visible until the final mean.

headline: The label chooses the log term
caption: Probability-input BCE clips endpoints; logits-input BCE uses the stable softplus form instead.

headline: The mask controls both the sum and the count
caption: Dividing by all elements would dilute the mean; divide by the number selected.

headline: Every prediction lands in one confusion bucket
caption: Build the four counts once, then derive every metric from them.

headline: A row is correct if its label appears in the top k
caption: The comparison broadcasts one target across the k candidates in each row.

headline: IoU is overlap divided by covered area
caption: Clamp the intersection width and height at zero when boxes do not overlap.

headline: Wrap the raw angle error back to one circle
caption: Angles near opposite ends of the interval can still be close on the circle.

headline: Small errors are quadratic; large errors are linear
caption: The two branches meet with the same value and slope at beta.

headline: Shift each row before exponentiating
caption: Subtracting one constant per row preserves softmax probabilities and prevents overflow.

headline: Weight each example by its target class
caption: Index the class-weight vector with labels to obtain one weight per example.

headline: Temperature changes confidence, not class order
caption: Dividing every logit by the same positive temperature preserves their ranking.

headline: Insert singleton axes to form every pair
caption: The new axes align N against M while leaving D as the feature axis.

headline: Pairwise dot products need pairwise norm products
caption: The denominator broadcasts one x norm down rows and one y norm across columns.

headline: Compress each class to one centroid
caption: Training stores one mean vector per class; prediction is nearest-neighbor over centroids.

headline: Broadcast N boxes against M boxes
caption: Singleton axes create every cross-set box pair without a Python loop.

headline: Keep the best box, suppress its duplicates, repeat
caption: NMS is greedy: every kept box changes which candidates remain.

headline: Coordinate weights say which errors matter most
caption: Keep the four-coordinate axis last so one weight vector broadcasts everywhere.

headline: Dice compares overlap with total foreground mass
caption: Dice directly rewards shared foreground pixels instead of counting background agreement.

headline: Segmentation IoU uses soft intersection and union
caption: Reduce spatial axes first so each image contributes one IoU before the batch mean.

headline: Easy examples shrink; hard examples keep their weight
caption: Compute p_t for the true label, then use its complement as the difficulty weight.

headline: Top-k chooses rows; gather retrieves their features
caption: Gather needs the index tensor to match every non-gathered axis.

headline: Translation becomes a matrix multiply after appending one
caption: The appended one lets the final transform column add translation.

headline: Expose grid axes and local patch axes
caption: Patchify is a layout change: it does not mix or learn pixel values.

headline: Split each token, restore the grid, then collapse
caption: Unpatchify exactly reverses the axis order used by patchify.

headline: Each position gets slow and fast sine waves
steps: sin on even, cos on odd
caption: Outer multiplication creates one angle for every position-frequency pair.

headline: Query row i can see key columns j <= i
caption: Rows are queries and columns are keys; that orientation determines the triangle.

headline: Rotate adjacent channel pairs by position
caption: Each adjacent pair acts like a 2D vector; the rotation preserves its length.

headline: Each token builds a weighted mixture of all values
caption: The score matrix compares every query token with every key token.

headline: Decode appends only the new keys and values
caption: Appending on any axis except sequence silently corrupts the cache layout.

headline: Many query heads can share fewer key/value heads
steps: Hq query heads + Hkv K/V heads
share each K/V head across groups
caption: MHA uses Hkv=Hq, GQA uses fewer K/V heads, and MQA uses one.

headline: Queries come from one sequence; keys and values from another
caption: The query length controls output rows; the source length controls score columns.

headline: A context window indexes next-token counts
steps: slide one token at a time
caption: The model remembers counts for exact contexts; unseen contexts need a fallback.

headline: Average precision is area under ranked precision-recall
caption: Ranking matters: the same matches in a different order can produce different AP.

headline: Each ground truth can be claimed once
caption: Mask used ground truths before argmax so later predictions cannot reuse them.

headline: Broadcast all box pairs, then reduce the ground-truth axis
caption: The M axis represents candidate ground truths and is the only axis reduced.

headline: Cache the forward values needed by the reverse chain
steps: loss gradient flows right to left
caption: Backprop multiplies each upstream gradient by the local derivative at that node.

headline: Forward computes activations; backward reuses them for gradients
caption: Every gradient has the same shape as the parameter it updates.

headline: The skip path must match before residual addition
caption: Identity skips are free only when spatial size and channel count already match.

headline: Remember 1-3-1, x4, then 3-4-6-3
caption: ResNet-50 is easiest to recall as the bottleneck path, fourfold expansion, and 3-4-6-3 stage depths.

headline: Downsample, save skips, then restore the image grid
caption: U-Net keeps encoder features as skips so the decoder can recover per-pixel detail after four downsampling steps.

headline: One shared feature map feeds three detection heads
caption: The heatmap finds centers; size and offset supply the box geometry around each peak.

headline: Add the intercept, solve, then reuse the design
caption: Train and test matrices must use the same intercept and feature-column order.

headline: Expand monomials before fitting the linear model
caption: Polynomial regression is linear in its expanded monomial features.

headline: Sort for position; count for frequency
caption: Median uses order, mode uses counts, and the interval uses standard error.

headline: Compare each test with the GPA ranking
caption: Spearman measures monotonic rank agreement; Pearson measures linear value agreement.

headline: The rising line stops at battery capacity
caption: A piecewise rule fits the observed saturation that a global line would miss.

headline: Mask the scores before the stable softmax
caption: All-masked query rows need an explicit zero distribution instead of NaNs.

headline: Stable loss and confusion counts share valid labels
caption: Rows provide recall denominators; columns provide precision denominators.

headline: Differentiate both Smooth L1 branches
caption: Mean reduction scales every elementwise derivative by the number of residuals.

headline: Repeated point IDs accumulate into one grid cell
caption: Counts provide the divisor and identify empty dense-grid rows.

headline: Transpose spatial axes, then flip one axis
caption: Quarter turns reindex pixels exactly and require no interpolation.

headline: Move twice through the line along its normal
caption: Dividing by the normal's squared length makes line scaling irrelevant.
